arabic text: YEH GHURBAT E ALI HAI, YE GHURBAT E ALI HAI
english translation text: THIS IS THE TRAGEDY OF IMAM ALI (AS)

arabic text: HAQ MAANGNE JO ZAHRA DARBAR MEIN GAYI HAI
english translation text: ZAHRA HAD TO GO TO THE DARBAR TO FIGHT FOR HER RIGHTS!

arabic text: AWAAZ AA RAHI HAI MEI BINTE MUSTAFA HU\nBABA KE KALMAGOYO MEI HI TO FATIMAH HU
english translation text: SHE CALLED OUT, I AM THE DAUGHTER OF MUSTAFA\nOH RECITERS OF THE KALIMA, I AM FATIMAH

arabic text: PEHCHAAN NE SE DUNIYA INKAR KAR RAHI HAI\nYE GHURBAT E ALI HAI
english translation text: THEY ALL KNOW WHO I AM, YET THEY’RE ALL DENYING ME\n- THIS IS THE TRAGEDY OF IMAM ALI (AS) -

arabic text: SUN KAR SALAM E HAIDER KOI NAHI HAI RUKTA\nWAJIB NAHI SAMJHTA KOI JAWAAB DENA
english translation text: HEARING THE SALAAM OF THE IMAM, NO ONE STOPS TO REPLY\nTHEY DON’T CONSIDER IT OBLIGATORY TO RESPOND TO HIM

arabic text: AFSOOS FATIMAH BHI YE BAAT JAANTI HAI\nYE GHURBAT E ALI HAI
english translation text: WHAT A PITY IT IS THAT HIS WIFE (FATIMAH) KNOWS THIS\n- THIS IS THE TRAGEDY OF IMAM ALI (AS) -

arabic text: MASJID ME SAR JHUKAYE, MAWLA KHARE HUWE HAI\nHAKIM KI TOHAMATON KO CHUP CHAAP SUN RAHE HAI
english translation text: IMAM IS STANDING IN THE MOSQUE, WITH HIS HEAD LOWERED\nSILENTLY LISTENING TO THE FALSE CHARGES LAID BY THE RULER

arabic text: SIDDIQA SAB KE AAGEY JHUTLAAI JAA RAHI HAI\nYE GHURBAT E ALI HAI
english translation text: THE TRUTHFUL ONE (ZAHRA) IS BEING TREATED LIKE A LIAR IN PUBLIC\n- THIS IS THE TRAGEDY OF IMAM ALI (AS) -

arabic text: KEHTI HAI ROKE ZAHRA JAANE NA DUNGI TANHA\nPATKE ME MURTAZA KE HAI HAAT SAYYADA KA
english translation text: CRYING SOFTLY ZAHRA TOLD IMAM ALI, 'I WON'T LET YOU GO ALONE'\nWHILST HOLDING THE WAISTBAND OF HER HUSBAND

arabic text: AAB HAI KISI KA DURRA AUR DUKHTAR E NABI HAI\nYE GHURBAT E ALI HAI
english translation text: NOW SOMEBODY LIFTS THEIR HAND TO SLAP THE DAUGHTER OF THE PROPHET\n- THIS IS THE TRAGEDY OF IMAM ALI (AS) -

arabic text: EK KOOCH MEIN PAHUNCH KAR DEKHA HAI MUJTABA NE\nZALIM NE ZARB MARI KAISE KHUDA HI JAANE
english translation text: WHEN IMAM HASAN ARRIVED AT THE SCENE HOW DID HE BEAR TO SEE\nTHE OPPRESSIVE RULER (LA) SLAPPING HIS MOTHER - ONLY GOD KNOWS

arabic text: BINTE NABI ZAMEEN PAR GHASH KHA KE GIR PARI HAI\nYE GHURBAT E ALI HAI
english translation text: THE DAUGHTER OF THE PROPHET FELL TO THE GROUND, UNCONSCIOUS\n- THIS IS THE TRAGEDY OF IMAM ALI (AS) -

arabic text: MAZLOOM E KARBALA KO YAAD AAGAYI SAKINA\nBETI PE MUSTAFA KI QUNFUZ (LA) KA HAAT UTHA
english translation text: IMAM HUSSAINREMEMBERED HIS DAUGHTER SAKINA\nWHEN QUNFUZ (LA) RAISED HIS HAND ON THE DAUGHTER OF THE PROPHET

arabic text: PEHLU MEIN MURTAZA KI TALWAAR RO PADI HAI\nYE GHURBAT E ALI HAI
english translation text: WHILE THE SWORD IN IMAM ALI’S SHEATH, BURST INTO TEARS\n- THIS IS THE TRAGEDY OF IMAM ALI (AS) -

arabic text: PEHLU BHI HAI SHIKASTA, HAATO PE BHI HAI CHAALE\nHAI AAP KI AMANAAT AAB AAP KE HAWALE
english translation text: HER (ZAHRA'S) RIBS WERE BROKEN, HIS (IMAM ALI'S) HANDS ARE BLISTERED\nTHIS IS YOUR TRUST BEING RETURNED TO YOU

arabic text: YE KEHKE MURTAZA NE MAYYAT NABI KO DI HAI\nYE GHURBAT E ALI HAI
english translation text: THIS IS WHAT IMAM ALI WAS SAYING WHEN LOWERING HER INTO THE GRAVE\n- THIS IS THE TRAGEDY OF IMAM ALI (AS) -

arabic text: KAAFI HAI BAS YE FIKRA, RONE KO ZINDAGI BHAR\nHAATO KO APNE AKSAR KEHTE THE MALKE HAIDER
english translation text: THESE WORDS WILL SUFFICE TO MAKE YOU CRY FOR YOUR WHOLE LIFE\nRUBBING HIS HANDS TOGETHER, IMAM ALI KEPT REPEATING

arabic text: KHAIBAR SHIKAN KI ZAUJA GHUT GHUT KE MARGAYI HAI\nYE GHURBAT E ALI HAI
english translation text: THE WIFE OF KHAYBER’S HERO DIED IN SUFFERING\n- THIS IS THE TRAGEDY OF IMAM ALI (AS) -

arabic text: KAISE LIKHE TAKALLUM GURBAT ALI WALI KI\nZAUJA SAHABIYON KE, DARBAR MEIN GAYI THI
english translation text: HOW CAN 'TAKALLUM' DESCRIBE THE AGONY OF IMAM ALI?\nHIS WIFE (ZAHRA) HAD AN AUDIENCE WITH THE 'COMPANIONS'

arabic text: BETI SHARAABIYON KE DARBAAR MEIN GAYI HAI\nYE GHURBAT E ALI HAI
english translation text: HIS DAUGHTER (ZAINAB) HAD AN AUDIENCE WITH DRUNKARDS\n- THIS IS THE TRAGEDY OF IMAM ALI (AS) -
